3 Vulnerability Analysis [completed]
Sudo Version: 1.9.15p5, Known Vulnerabilities: CVE-2025-32462: Local Privilege Escalation via `host` option. No known workaround. Impacts `sudo` versions from 1.9.0 to 1.9.17. CVE-2025-32463: Local Privilege Escalation via `chroot` option. Affects Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.10, and Ubuntu 25.04 systems running `sudo` versions from 1.9.0 to 1.9.17. The `chroot` option has been deprecated as of version 1.9.17p1. CVE-2023-42465: Row Hammer Attack (Authentication Bypass or Privilege Escalation). Affects `sudo` versions prior to 1.9.15, including 1.9.15p5 in some distributions. Addressed in `sudo` version 1.9.15p2-2 or higher for Debian. Exploitation: Both CVE-2025-32462 and CVE-2025-32463 are local privilege escalation vulnerabilities. Verified on systems like Ubuntu 24.04.1 and Fedora 41 Server with `sudo` 1.9.15p5. Remediation: Update `sudo` to version 1.9.17p1 or later. Updating system through standard package management should apply necessary patches. References: Ubuntu Security Notice USN-7604-1, University of Toronto Information Security Advisory, Sudo Project Advisories (host\_any and chroot\_bug), Snyk Vulnerability Database, Mageia Bugzilla (regarding sudo-1.9.15p5-1.mga9.src.rpm).
